CustomField.description: Makes the agent conversational. After each answer the run waits this many hours for the person's next message, with the conversation so far in the transcript. Blank ends the run with its first answer.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Blank ends the run after its answer. Use a whole number from 1 to 168 to keep the run open for the next reply; it ends with its last answer when the window expires. Leave blank for agents used by channel routes.
CustomField.label: Wait for Reply (Hours)
